properties.title: LP APS Polonium-210 Relative Count Rate
properties.grid_note: 336 equal-area pixels, ~300 km (longitude) × ~450 km (latitude) at equator. Within the 720×360 binary container, each cell value is repeated across all 0.5° pixels covering that cell.
properties.processing:lineage: Raw INT16 binary (polonium210.dat) scaled ÷1000 via gdal_calc.py to obtain ²¹⁰Po counts/s as Float32. Binary values are 1000× the ASCII count rate values. Data acquired during high- and low-altitude mission phases (Lawson et al. 2002). Written as COG via gdal_translate with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
